description: Turn on DNSSEC for an agent's domain in one step (signs the zone and publishes the DS at the registry), so its TLSA record counts: without DNSSEC a TLSA record is ignored and the DANE step of check_ans_agent does not apply. Only for domains registered at Porkbun on Porkbun nameservers in this account; ANS_DNSSEC_UNAVAILABLE otherwise. Resolvers see it within a few hours; run check_ans_agent again after that. Ask the user first: it changes how the whole domain resolves.

agent_id.description: The agentId from register_ans_agent or list_ans_agents.

name: enable_ans_dnssec
title: Enable Ans DNSSEC
